targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_sources FROM SourceTable
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_sources FROM SourceTable

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_citations FROM CitationTable
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_citations FROM CitationTable

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) as unused_sources FROM SourceTable s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CitationTable c WHERE c.SourceID = s.SourceID)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) as unused_sources FROM SourceTable s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CitationTable c WHERE c.SourceID = s.SourceID)

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(AVG(citation_count), 2) as avg_citations FROM (SELECT s.SourceID, COUNT(c.CitationID) as citation_count FROM SourceTable s LEFT JOIN CitationTable c ON s.SourceID = c.SourceID GROUP BY s.SourceID)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(AVG(citation_count), 2) as avg_citations FROM (SELECT s.SourceID, COUNT(c.CitationID) as citation_count FROM SourceTable s LEFT JOIN CitationTable c ON s.SourceID = c.SourceID GROUP BY s.SourceID)

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN TemplateID = 0 THEN 'Free-Form' ELSE 'Template' END as source_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM SourceTable GROUP BY source_type
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN TemplateID = 0 THEN 'Free-Form' ELSE 'Template' END as source_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM SourceTable GROUP BY source_type

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN Name LIKE '%Census%' THEN 'Census' WHEN Name LIKE '%Birth%' THEN 'Vital - Birth' WHEN Name LIKE '%Death%' THEN 'Vital - Death' WHEN Name LIKE '%Marriage%' THEN 'Vital - Marriage' WHEN Name LIKE '%Grave%' OR Name LIKE '%Cemetery%' THEN 'Cemetery' WHEN Name LIKE '%Church%' OR Name LIKE '%Baptis%' THEN 'Church' WHEN Name LIKE '%Military%' OR Name LIKE '%War%' THEN 'Military' ELSE 'Other' END as source_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM SourceTable GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY count DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN Name LIKE '%Census%' THEN 'Census' WHEN Name LIKE '%Birth%' THEN 'Vital - Birth' WHEN Name LIKE '%Death%' THEN 'Vital - Death' WHEN Name LIKE '%Marriage%' THEN 'Vital - Marriage' WHEN Name LIKE '%Grave%' OR Name LIKE '%Cemetery%' THEN 'Cemetery' WHEN Name LIKE '%Church%' OR Name LIKE '%Baptis%' THEN 'Church' WHEN Name LIKE '%Military%' OR Name LIKE '%War%' THEN 'Military' ELSE 'Other' END as source_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM SourceTable GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY count DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE cl.OwnerType WHEN 0 THEN 'Person' WHEN 1 THEN 'Family' WHEN 2 THEN 'Event' WHEN 7 THEN 'Name' ELSE 'Other' END as owner_type, COUNT(*) as link_count FROM CitationLinkTable cl GROUP BY cl.OwnerType ORDER BY link_count DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE cl.OwnerType WHEN 0 THEN 'Person' WHEN 1 THEN 'Family' WHEN 2 THEN 'Event' WHEN 7 THEN 'Name' ELSE 'Other' END as owner_type, COUNT(*) as link_count FROM CitationLinkTable cl GROUP BY cl.OwnerType ORDER BY link_count DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN citation_count = 0 THEN 'Unused (0)' WHEN citation_count = 1 THEN '1 citation' WHEN citation_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5 citations' WHEN citation_count BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN '6-20 citations' WHEN citation_count > 20 THEN '20+ citations' END as range_label, COUNT(*) as source_count FROM (SELECT s.SourceID, COUNT(c.CitationID) as citation_count FROM SourceTable s LEFT JOIN CitationTable c ON s.SourceID = c.SourceID GROUP BY s.SourceID) GROUP BY range_label ORDER BY MIN(citation_count)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN citation_count = 0 THEN 'Unused (0)' WHEN citation_count = 1 THEN '1 citation' WHEN citation_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5 citations' WHEN citation_count BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN '6-20 citations' WHEN citation_count > 20 THEN '20+ citations' END as range_label, COUNT(*) as source_count FROM (SELECT s.SourceID, COUNT(c.CitationID) as citation_count FROM SourceTable s LEFT JOIN CitationTable c ON s.SourceID = c.SourceID GROUP BY s.SourceID) GROUP BY range_label ORDER BY MIN(citation_count)
